label: All sessions are scripted TEST DOUBLES started through the Kane invocation boundary. They measure the machinery, not any agent.
dataset: P5 development and dry-run dataset (U1, D93)

profiles.label: TEST DOUBLE: measures the measuring machinery, not an agent

coverage.unit: held-out situations with at least one prediction ÷ held-out situations (assertions made ÷ opportunities)

accuracy.unit: held-out outcome checks matching ÷ checks with a recorded outcome (over assertions made; descriptive)

incorrectAssertions.unit: held-out outcome checks contradicted by the recorded outcome (count, not netted against anything)

detection.unit: held-out (rule, build) spec deviations with an accurate description of a defect ÷ deviations present; abstention counts as not detected

citations.unit: evidence ids cited in submissions; cited before the server journal records that page served to this session

abstentionCheck.why: The over-abstaining profile makes no assertion, so it has no contradicted prediction: it is "better" on incorrect assertions only because it asserts nothing. Its accuracy has no denominator (no rate), its coverage is 0 and its detection counts every abstention as not detected, so it never ranks above the accurate profile on those (EXPERIMENT_DESIGN §3 abstention handling).

rule: Dimensions are reported side by side and never combined; no ranking by a single column is reported. Detection counts abstention as not detected; error counts are over assertions made.
